_what_this_is: Sources and venues found by AGENT WEB SEARCH on 2026-07-26, at founder direction: 'surely your work accesses multiple sources to verify what a place is, including something as simple as a web search... using all the local sources we've identified eg am fm radio, local periodicals, etc.'
_trust_status: UNVERIFIED. Every row here is a LEAD, not a fact. A search result is a far weaker claim than a TABC licence, and nothing in this file may be treated as equal to one. Each row carries the query that produced it and the page that asserted it, so any claim can be traced back. Rows enter the source registry with origin 'web_discovery' and status NEVER_TRIED until a real fetch proves the feed exists and parses — the scorecard already distinguishes 'we have not measured this' from 'this is broken', and that distinction is the whole safety property here.
_why_it_matters: TABC sees establishments licensed to serve mixed beverages. It cannot see the Texas dance hall circuit, county fairgrounds, performing-arts nonprofits, theatres, or the chamber-of-commerce and visitor-bureau calendars where the outer counties actually publish. Seven of the ten CAPCOG counties had ZERO curated sources before this pass.
_method_is_portable: The queries come from tools/venue_discovery_plan.py, which templates them per county and per source class. Swap the county list and the same plan works for any metro — no Austin-specific knowledge is hard-coded in the method, only in these results.
_headline_find: THE TEXAS MUSIC OFFICE INDUSTRY DIRECTORY (gov.texas.gov/Apps/Music/Directory/). State-operated, 15,000+ listings, free, NO CREDENTIAL REQUIRED, and filterable by region and by category — including 'Live Music Venues', 'Clubs, Dancehalls, Small Venues' and 'Radio Stations'. This is a better layer 3 than the Places API for this product's purpose: Places knows what a business IS, but the TMO directory knows which businesses are MUSIC venues, which is the actual question. It is also the direct answer to what TABC structurally cannot see, and unlike Places it costs nothing and waits on no founder action. Highest-value next build.

sources.name: Texas Music Office — Industry Directory (Live Music Venues)
sources.note: State-run, free, no credential. Region- and category-filterable. Enumerates VENUES (a denominator layer), and separately lists Clubs/Dancehalls/Small Venues and Radio Stations. Music-specific where TABC is alcohol-specific — it sees the all-ages and alcohol-free rooms TABC cannot, and excludes the restaurants TABC wrongly includes.
